rationale: The original thesis relied on price holding the 5-minute 9-EMA ($168.45) and consolidating tightly, which has now broken down as the last two 1-minute candles closed at their lows ($168.40 and $168.19) on expanding sell volume (8,403 shares on the breakdown bar).
